thread:
Aisha: Quick idea 9: propose an SI Onramp + Catalog Playbook to standardize how SIs get listed in cloud marketplaces and validated on hardware partners. Target: 6-week pilot cohort, gated deliverables for catalog listing. Thoughts?

Marco: Sounds good. We need a concrete catalog readiness checklist (manifest, support contact, SLA doc, security attestation). Map those to certification gates.

Lena: I'll own curriculum. Suggest 3 tiers: Onramp (listing basics), Certified Integrator (deploy+perf), Partner Premier (refs + co-sell).

Diego: Hardware side: we need a "reference stack" spec + firmware/driver checklist and an automated perf harness. I'll supply A100/8x50Gb baseline numbers.

Ben: For verification, propose a practical lab (deploy to ephemeral sandbox) + short MC quiz. Passing rule: practical >=80% and overall >=75%.

Raj: Marketing asks: Premier requires a joint case study or customer reference within 6 months. Also need a one-pager and co-sell slide template.

Lena: Draft syllabus (high level): Week 0 intake, Week 1 platform fundamentals, Week 2 catalog & listing lab, Week 3 hardware perf tuning, Week 4 security/KMS runbook, Week 5 troubleshooting & docs, Week 6 exam + demo day.

Marco: I'll provide sample manifests for AWS/Azure/GCP and expected review lead times so SIs can plan listing windows.

Diego: Example perf command (pseudo):
# perf-check.sh
./run_perf --model gpt-xl --batch 8 --seq 1024 --concurrency 4 --report perf.json
Include thermal and driver checks in runbook.

Lena: Labs infra: GH Actions to spin ephemeral sandboxes and a scoring webhook that returns a grade. Need a simple rubric for graders and machine-checkable artifacts (logs, perf.json, manifest).

Aisha: Action list + owners: Aisha: playbook & certification matrix (Tue 9am); Lena: modules + labs scaffold (Wed); Marco: marketplace manifests + checklist (Tue); Diego: reference stack + perf thresholds (Thu); Raj: marketing templates (Fri).

Legal: We have an MOU template for co-marketing; will post link and required clauses. Partnerships, loop Legal early.

Integrations-Bot: New doc created in docs: /partnerships/si-onramp-catalog-playbook (draft). Tag label: partnerships/si-onramp.

Ben: Recommend pilot cohort = 6 SIs (mix marketplace-first & hardware-focused). Need a dedicated Slack channel: #si-onramp-pilot.

Aisha: I'll create the channel and an intake form. Pilot kickoff target: 3 weeks from now; demo day end of week 9. We'll run a short retro after demo day and adjust the playbook. :white_check_mark:
